item.title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
item.description: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

item.title: Watch: Timelapse shows typhoon barrelling towards Japan
item.description: The typhoon is passing Japan's eastern coast, bringing major disruption and heavy rainfall in its wake.

item.title: What to expect as world leaders descend on New York - and who won't be there
item.description: The BBC’s Sarah Smith outlines which world leaders Trump is set to meet and the key topics expected on the agenda.

item.title: Why is the Bab al-Mandab Strait so important?
item.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner explains why the narrow waterway is key to oil transportation and the world economy.

item.title: Why a Bollywood celebrity manager's 2020 death case has been reopened
item.description: Disha Salian's father insists her death was not suicide or an accident, but that she was gang-raped and murdered.

item.title: What is the White House pool and why is it in a row with Trump?
item.description: The White House press pool is at the centre of a major row between President Donald Trump and TV networks. What is it?

item.title: Neutral venues and no 'away' fans - how Israel v Republic of Ireland became so contentious
item.description: BBC Sport explores the backdrop to the Republic of Ireland's matches against Israel, amid fraught tensions between the nations.

item.title: 'I have never felt heat like that' - a survivor on watching 33 cellmates die in Nigeria
item.description: The BBC goes inside the prison where prisoners were trapped in stifling, cramped conditions.

item.title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
item.description: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

item.title: Doctor in court to face Rwanda genocide charges in UK
item.description: Dr Vincent Brown was charged following a seven year British investigation into the 1994 killings.

item.title: Texas ICE shooting leaves Venezuelan DoorDash driver with bullet in his back, says lawyer
item.description: The delivery driver was transferred from a hospital to a detention centre, his lawyer tells US media.

item.title: Call of Duty's Activision to make next Halo game as Xbox cuts more jobs
item.description: The news comes as part of a "reset" announced by Xbox in July, with 3,600 planned job losses overall.

item.title: Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan
item.description: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.

item.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

item.title: Veteran BBC Africa correspondent Mark Doyle dies aged 67
item.description: Doyle was best known for reporting on African conflicts in the 1990s and 2000s, notably in Rwanda and Sierra Leone.

item.title: Cyclist who dressed as man to avoid Taliban wins silver medal
item.description: Afghan cyclist Fariba Hashimi wins silver in the women's road race at the Asian Games, having fled oppression in her home country to pursue a sporting dream.

item.title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
item.description: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system - was ruled an accident.

item.title: Top South African policeman charged with sexual offences
item.description: Shadrack Sibiya, who has made no comment, is alleged to have groomed a 16-year-old and raped an 18-year-old.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to investigate juror and check his phone
item.description: The attorney wants the court to look at the juror's mobile phone use and answers on questionnaires.

item.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
item.description: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.

item.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
item.description: Scientists say the developing El Niño is now the strongest on record with weather impacts already being felt around the world.

item.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
item.description: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.
